constraint1:
Constraint 1: Assign each operation of every job to exactly one of its eligible machines.
Constraint 2: Operations within each job must follow their prescribed processing order.
Constraint 3: A machine may process only one operation at a time; operations on the same machine must not overlap.
Constraint 4: The makespan must be at least the completion time of every job.
Constraint 5: All operation start times must be nonnegative.
Constraint 6: Job 1 must not begin processing before time 500; starting exactly at 500 is allowed.
code1:
# Constraint 6: Job 1 must not begin processing before time 500; starting exactly at 500 is allowed.
    model.addConstr(B[0, 0] >= 500, name="start_time_lower_bound_1")

constraint2:
Constraint 1: Every operation must be allocated to one and only one compatible machine.
Constraint 2: For each job, an operation may start only after its preceding operation has finished.
Constraint 3: Operations assigned to a common machine must be scheduled without overlapping processing intervals.
Constraint 4: The overall completion time cannot be smaller than any individual job's completion time.
Constraint 5: No operation is allowed to start before time zero.
Constraint 6: The start of Job 2 must be scheduled no later than time 200, including 200.
code2:
# Constraint 7: The start of Job 2 must be scheduled no later than time 200, including 200.
    model.addConstr(B[1, 0] <= 200, name="start_time_upper_bound_2")

constraint3:
Constraint 1: Select exactly one machine from the eligible set for each operation of each job.
Constraint 2: Respect the specified precedence sequence among the operations of a job.
Constraint 3: On any given machine, processing intervals of different operations must be mutually exclusive.
Constraint 4: The makespan must cover the completion of all jobs.
Constraint 5: The start time of every operation must be greater than or equal to zero.
Constraint 6: Job 3 must start within the time window from 500 to 600, with both endpoints included.
code3:
# Constraint 8: Job 3 must start within the time window from 500 to 600, with both endpoints included.
    model.addConstr(B[2, 0] >= 500, name="start_time_lower_bound_3")
    model.addConstr(B[2, 0] <= 600, name="start_time_upper_bound_3")

constraint4:
Constraint 1: Each job operation is to be processed on exactly one machine capable of performing it.
Constraint 2: A job's operations must be processed in the required order, with each predecessor completed before its successor starts.
Constraint 3: Each machine has unit capacity and cannot process two operations simultaneously.
Constraint 4: The makespan cannot precede the finishing time of any job.
Constraint 5: Operation start times are restricted to zero or later.
Constraint 6: The earliest permitted start time for Job 4 is 750; it may begin exactly at 750.
code4:
# Constraint 7: The earliest permitted start time for Job 4 is 750; it may begin exactly at 750.
    model.addConstr(B[3, 0] >= 750, name="start_time_lower_bound_4")

constraint5:
Constraint 1: For every operation, choose one eligible machine and assign the operation to that machine alone.
Constraint 2: All operations belonging to the same job must satisfy the given precedence relationships.
Constraint 3: Any two operations processed by the same machine must have non-overlapping processing intervals.
Constraint 4: Every job must finish no later than the makespan.
Constraint 5: Starting an operation at a negative time is prohibited.
Constraint 6: Job 5 must begin processing by time 300. A start at 300 satisfies this requirement.
code5:
# Constraint 8: Job 5 must begin processing by time 300. A start at 300 satisfies this requirement.
    model.addConstr(B[4, 0] <= 300, name="start_time_upper_bound_5")

constraint6:
Constraint 1: Each operation must receive exactly one assignment among its compatible machines.
Constraint 2: Within a job, the next operation cannot begin until the previous operation is complete.
Constraint 3: Machine processing must be sequential: no two operations on a machine may run at the same time.
Constraint 4: The makespan is required to be no less than the finishing time of each job.
Constraint 5: The earliest permissible start time for any operation is zero.
Constraint 6: The start time of Job 6 must lie between 400 and 550, inclusive.
code6:
# Constraint 9: The start time of Job 6 must lie between 400 and 550, inclusive.
    model.addConstr(B[5, 0] >= 400, name="start_time_lower_bound_6")
    model.addConstr(B[5, 0] <= 550, name="start_time_upper_bound_6")

constraint7:
Constraint 1: An operation must be assigned to a single machine selected from its eligible machine set.
Constraint 2: The prescribed order of operations must be maintained separately for every job.
Constraint 3: Operations sharing a machine must be ordered so that one finishes before or when the next begins.
Constraint 4: The makespan must upper-bound the completion times of all jobs.
Constraint 5: Every operation must have a start time of at least zero.
Constraint 6: Job 7 cannot start earlier than time 800, but a start at 800 is permitted.
code7:
# Constraint 7: Job 7 cannot start earlier than time 800, but a start at 800 is permitted.
    model.addConstr(B[6, 0] >= 800, name="start_time_lower_bound_7")

constraint8:
Constraint 1: Exactly one eligible machine is required to process each operation.
Constraint 2: For each job, enforce the given operation sequence without allowing a successor to start before its predecessor finishes.
Constraint 3: A machine cannot be occupied by more than one processing operation at any instant.
Constraint 4: The schedule's makespan must be at least as large as each job's completion time.
Constraint 5: All processing start times are constrained to be nonnegative.
Constraint 6: Job 8 must start at or before time 250; equality is allowed.
code8:
# Constraint 8: Job 8 must start at or before time 250; equality is allowed.
    model.addConstr(B[7, 0] <= 250, name="start_time_upper_bound_8")

constraint9:
Constraint 1: Allocate every job operation to exactly one machine from the set on which it can be processed.
Constraint 2: The operations of each job must obey their specified precedence order.
Constraint 3: Processing on a shared machine must not overlap between operations.
Constraint 4: No job's completion time may exceed the makespan.
Constraint 5: An operation can start at time zero or any later time, but never earlier.
Constraint 6: Job 9 must begin processing in the interval from 600 to 900, including both boundary values.
code9:
# Constraint 9: Job 9 must begin processing in the interval from 600 to 900, including both boundary values.
    model.addConstr(B[8, 0] >= 600, name="start_time_lower_bound_9")
    model.addConstr(B[8, 0] <= 900, name="start_time_upper_bound_9")

constraint10:
Constraint 1: Each operation has to be processed by one, and only one, eligible machine.
Constraint 2: Maintain the required processing sequence for each job, ensuring that consecutive operations satisfy finish-to-start precedence.
Constraint 3: Schedule operations on each machine one at a time, with no overlap in their processing intervals.
Constraint 4: The makespan must not be less than the completion time of any job in the schedule.
Constraint 5: Require a nonnegative start time for every operation.
Constraint 6: Every job must start no earlier than time 20. Starting exactly at 20 is allowed.
